messages:
alice: heads up — canary deploy at 17:59 pushed kernel_autoselect + batch_hint change. Hosted small-model p99 jumped ~90ms -> ~320ms. looks deploy-related

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-12T17:59Z by dmitri — runtime.kernel_autoselect=enabled, runtime.batch_hint=8 — canary 5% hosts

ben: ack. pulling dashboards now. where are the p99 tail traces?

carol: seeing same in graphs. p50 unchanged. p95 up slightly. p99 shows big queue_wait component + kernel step uptick.

dmitri: I pushed both changes to speed up throughput. microbatch hint bumped 4->8 and autoselect to prefer vector kernels for throughput. didn't expect tail blowup.

eva: quick question — any change in KV cache hit rate? could batch reordering cause more cache misses across shards?

dmitri: kv cache _rates_ look flat. attaching quick profiler snippet:
```
Profile slice:
queue_wait_ms: p50=12 p95=60 p99=220
kernel_exec_ms (small_seq_kernel_v2): p50=8 p95=18 p99=80
kv_cache_lookup_ms: p50=1 p95=3 p99=5
cpu_wait_ms: p50=2 p95=6 p99=10
```

carol: that queue_wait p99 = 220ms explains it. not pure kernel slowness, it's head-of-line microbatch queuing for small sequences.

alice: agreed — increasing microbatch hint to 8 will make small single-shot requests wait longer while server fills batches. p50 stays fine but tail suffers.

ben: two quick mitigations: revert batch_hint to 4 or pin kernel to previous fast_small_seq (avoid autoselect). Which is faster to flip?

dmitri: pinning kernel is cheaper runtime config change (no restart). reverting batch_hint requires rolling config with restarts on some hosts. I can flip kernel flag immediately.

eva: recommendation: pin kernel first (non-disruptive), then rollback batch_hint if tail not fixed. Also add guard on kernel_autoselect to skip vector kernels for seq_len <= 64.

carol: +1. i'll prepare a canary-only kernel pin and schedule a small rollout. also will run seq_len heatmap to confirm distribution.

alice: please check request size distro; if most are <=64, batching=8 is counterproductive.

deploy-bot: starting job jb-9921 — set runtime.kernel_autoselect=false on canary pool

deploy-bot: job jb-9921 completed — config applied to 5% canary hosts

ben: monitoring dashboards — p99 trending down: 320 -> 110 -> 95ms on canary. nice.

dmitri: confirmed kernel pin fixed tail. I'll open PR to roll back the batching default change and add the seq_len guard to autoselect logic.

alice: create ticket for postmortem + add a quick perf test to catch this pattern (small seq + batch_hint) in canary.

eva: created INF-1127 for seq_len guard + INF-1128 for canary perf test.

carol: :thumbsup:

alice: thanks everyone — leaving the canary pinned until we ship the guard. follow-ups in INF-1127/1128.
